name: Suzuka Kazuma
source:
A sporty boy in the Basketball Club with a direct, head-on personality. He has enough skill to have been a regular starter since his first year, but because he plays selfishly, he often gets scolded by his coach. His future dream is to "go to America and play basketball." In truth, he is terrified of ghosts.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
